meta.name: gpus.json
meta.title: e2ugh v6 - Unified Virtual GPU Database
meta.description: Union of the v5 GPU database (7 virtual identity identities), the S6 registry (RX 8900 XTX + Arc B770 unique), Blackwell architecture specs v5+v6 (B100/GB200/RTX 5070/5070 Ti SKUs), gpu.config TOML SKUs (incl. 5 AMD APU RDNA iGPUs) and the 11-entry vfio profile table. PCI device id for RTX PRO 6000 corrected 2BB5->26B5 per canonical v5.

mergeReport.driverConflictResolution: rtx5090.json mini driver 575.51.03 loses to gpu.json v5 driver policy (R570 min, R580/R590 branches Aug 2026); b200 keeps catalog driver 580.105.08

shims.name: fake-nvidia-smi
shims.mechanism: pure-Python virtual nvidia-smi adapter CLI replacement, profile-driven

shims.name: nvml-unified-shim
shims.mechanism: LD_PRELOAD libnvml-unified.so wrapping nvmlDeviceGetCount/GetMemoryInfo/GetName via dlsym(RTLD_NEXT) with CUDA runtime fallback; built for DGX Spark GB10 unified memory (Driver 580.126.09, CUDA 12.8); env NVML_SHIM_DEBUG=1

shims.name: GpuAdapter
shims.mechanism: intercepts libcuda/libcudart/libcublas/libnvidia-ml/libnccl entry points via LD_PRELOAD (Linux) or DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES (macOS); supports --devices 'a100:2,h100:2'

shims.name: fake-gpu-operator
shims.mechanism: Kubernetes operator installing a Go virtual nvidia-smi adapter + virtual device plugin, profile-driven driver/CUDA versions

mig.description: NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU: hardware partitioning of one GPU into isolated instances with own memory, SMs and fault domains.

guestTargeting.cudaVisibleDevices: MIG-<uuid> (e.g. MIG-e2f6a23a-...) or GPU index when single instance
guestTargeting.vfio: MIG instances are not SR-IOV VFs; pass the parent GPU with vfio-pci and expose MIG via container toolkit or nested driver

mig.engineUse: vRAM modularity 24/48/96 GB slices via the inference-mig VM profile (vm.config.json)

spoofTargets.nvidiaSmi: virtual CLI + NVML shim (tools read libnvidia-ml.so: nvidia-smi, gpustat, pynvml)
spoofTargets.rocmSmi: profile-driven virtual rocm-smi output for AMD identities
spoofTargets.clinfo: Rusticl device name/CL version override (see mesa.json RUSTICL_DEVICE_TYPE/RUSTICL_CL_VERSION)
spoofTargets.vulkaninfo: VK_DRIVER_FILES + Mesa Vulkan device name virtual identity (see mesa.json)
unspoofableWithoutVm: GPU hardware PCI ids visible to lspci on real hardware (use QEMU vfio-user/passthrough for true device emulation)

vramConfigToml.stepNote: 1 MB granularity for fine-grained vGPU slicing and passthrough accounting
